commands:
git checkout -b fix/issue-7-login-loop && git add src/auth.js && git commit -m "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() when session expires (fixes #7)

refresh() called itself forever on an expired session, freezing the
page. It now delegates to a new fetchSession() that fetches a fresh
session from the server." && git push -u origin fix/issue-7-login-loop

gh pr create --title "Fix login loop when the session cookie expires" --body "Fixes #7.

\`refresh()\` in \`src/auth.js\` recursed into itself whenever \`session.expired\` was true, freezing the page. It now delegates to a new \`fetchSession()\` helper that fetches a fresh session from \`/api/session\`. Live sessions are still returned unchanged.

- \`refresh()\` is now async (it returns the fetched session when the old one expired)
- verified with a mocked fetch: expired session → new session; live session → returned as-is"
